question: After the shell-harness repair and final branch refresh, does one successful immutable ledger replay on the exact final SHA provide sufficient evidence to make the ledger mandatory for every regular release path?
rationale: The patch intentionally changes publication from the existing release evidence flow to an additional fail-closed cross-workflow gate; accepting the historical reconciliation and operational dependency requires release-owner intent, not model judgment.

options.title: Require exact-final-head replay
options.body: Keep the PR open until a successful ledger artifact for the final SHA is accepted by candidate, release-publish, and npm-publish consumers.

options.title: Stage enforcement separately
options.body: Land provenance generation and validation first, then enable mandatory publication blocking after a successful end-to-end release rehearsal.

recommendation.title: Require exact-final-head replay
recommendation.body: Keep the PR open until a successful ledger artifact for the final SHA is accepted by candidate, release-publish, and npm-publish consumers.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored the publication-enforcement commits and is the strongest history-backed owner for accepting the new release gate.
